🚨 Chelsea have been linked with a surprise move for Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi.

New Blues boss Xabi Alonso is reportedly keen on the World Cup winner, but Arsenal have no intention of letting him leave — despite the £75M arrival of Bruno Guimarães.

(Source: Mundo Deportivo
